title: Certificates of Deposit: whether a jumbo top-up stays within the grace add-on total and the source account balance
content:
## Scope

When the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate in its grace period asks to add just enough money for the certificate to earn the jumbo bonus when it renews, the top-up must fit two limits. This rule states both and how they are measured.

## Rule

1. **Room left under the grace total.** The top-up must fit within the room left under the tier's most added per grace period, which is that figure less the grace add-ons already made in the current grace period.
2. **Source account balance.** The top-up must also be no more than the current balance of the owner's active PCB savings or money market account from which it is made.
3. **Grace add-ons already made.** The grace add-ons already made in the current grace period are the grace add-on deposits posted within the one month before the current date. That window covers the whole current grace period and no earlier one, because grace periods are at least six months apart.

## Check table

| Measure | Reading | Top-up must be |
|---|---|---|
| Grace add-ons already made | Grace add-on deposits posted within the one month before the current date | Taken off the tier's most added per grace period |
| Room left under the grace total | Most added per grace period, less the grace add-ons already made | At least as large as the top-up |
| Source account | Current balance of the owner's active savings or money market account | At least as large as the top-up |

## Cases (illustrative grace total of 20000.00, not a tier value)

| Grace add-ons already made in the last month | Room left | Source account balance | Top-up | Within both limits? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 20000.00 | 9000.00 | 3500.00 | Yes |
| 18000.00 | 2000.00 | 9000.00 | 3500.00 | No, above the room left |
| 0.00 | 20000.00 | 3499.99 | 3500.00 | No, above the account balance |
| 16500.00 | 3500.00 | 3500.00 | 3500.00 | Yes, equal to both is enough |

## Points of judgement

**A grace add-on was made in the grace period of the previous maturity, many months ago. Does it reduce the room left?**
No. Only grace add-on deposits posted within the one month before the current date are counted.
